The scene is enveloped in a thick, teal-tinted fog that creates a moody, ethereal atmosphere. The car's headlights are turned on, casting powerful beams of warm light through the mist. To the left, the silhouettes of towering palm trees and a suburban house loom in the background, while a solitary streetlamp glows on the right, further illuminating the hazy green air.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: The page positions the three current models on a quality-to-speed/cost ladder: Nano Banana Pro for studio-quality precision and control (built on Gemini 3), Nano Banana 2 for pro-level quality at Flash speed, and Nano Banana 2 Lite as the fastest, most efficient, lowest-cost option.

The page's prompting emphasis is consistently on detail: models respond to 'even the most detailed prompts', capture prompt nuance, and the 'Creating your prompts' section is illustrated by a long, layered scene description.
